page_summary: This report provides an overview of cybersecurity in ports, based on a survey of 109 stakeholders. It highlights the challenges faced in high-income versus low- and middle-income countries, emphasizing the need for improved policy, practice, and addressing barriers. The report stresses that while some progress has been made, significant gaps remain, particularly in resource allocation and consistent practices, which are crucial for enhancing port cybersecurity.
